newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's rates Govt Housing Bank of Thailand A3/P2.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Govt Housing Bank of Thailand A3/P2.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it assigned an A3 rating to the long-term senior debt and long-term deposits of the Government Housing Bank of Thailand.
The agency, which was assessing the bank for the first time, also rated its short-term deposits at Prime-2 and gave a D-plus for its Bank Financial Strength Rating (BFSR).
The bank's US$200 million Floating Rating Note, due in 2001 and which carries a guarantee to interest payment and principal by the Ministry of Finance, was also rated A3.
Moody's said the bank's asset quality has been historically good but has shown negative trends during 1996 in line with slowdown in Thailand's economic growth.
